compute_checksum_artifact: compute a SHA checksum for a local artifact folder and write it to a checksum file
tar_and_upload_artifact: tar an artifact directory excluding hidden files and upload the archive to an S3 bucket
compute_checksum_tar_and_upload: compute a checksum for an artifact, create a tar archive, and upload it to S3 in one step
upload_agent_datasets: compute checksum and upload agent dataset artifacts to the S3 craftassist bucket
upload_agent_models: compute checksum and upload agent model artifacts like NLU or policy models to S3
